{{Top|leg}}
An '''emergency shelter''' was a lightweight two-person [[Tent/Legends|tent]] constructed of a composite-metal skin over a metal skeletal frame. They were carried and stored in a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier's]] [[Backpack/Legends|backpack]]. Specially ordered emergency shelters could be completely sealed from the elements with access ports for communications antenna.
